translations.title: Clonixin Lysinate 125 mg Soft Capsule
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used to relieve mild to moderate pain such as muscle pain, neuralgia, pain after injury or surgery, headache, toothache and earache.
translations.usage: Adults take one to two capsules (125–250 mg) three times a day. Do not take it together with other anti-inflammatory painkillers.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you have a peptic ulcer; if you have ever had asthma, hives or an allergy to this medicine, aspirin or other anti-inflammatory painkillers; for pain around CABG surgery; if you are pregnant; or if you have severe liver or kidney impairment, heart failure or inflammatory bowel disease. If you have had high blood pressure, bronchial asthma, or liver or kidney impairment, talk to a pharmacist before taking it.

summaryTable.Main symptoms: Muscle pain, neuralgia, headache, toothache, earache, pain after injury or surgery
summaryTable.Who should be careful: Peptic ulcer, severe liver or kidney impairment, pregnancy
